## Research Scope & Dimensions

This is an exploration on how LibGuides frame, teach, and operationalize **Artificial Intelligence (AI) Literacy** across higher education. 

Using an LLM extraction pipeline with verbatim quote verification and high-dimensional semantic embeddings, this exercise investigates five core dimensions:

1. **Definitions & Conceptual Models**: Formal explicit definitions vs. implicit competencies (Leo Lo [-@loAILiteracyAll2025]’s framework, Bloom-aligned models, ACRL threshold concepts).
2. **Instructional Objectives & Learning Outcomes**: Student skills (prompt engineering, lateral fact-checking, bias detection) and faculty pedagogical goals (assignment redesign, syllabus clarity).
3. **Institutional Guidelines & Policies**: Permitted vs. prohibited use spectra, citation protocols (APA, MLA, Chicago, IEEE), and syllabus policy tiers.
4. **Instructional Frameworks & Heuristics**: Named rubrics including the **ROBOT Test**, **CLEAR Prompting Framework**, **PAIR/PAIRR Models**, and **Lateral Reading**.
5. **Curricular Semantic Alignment**: Pairwise vector similarity and hierarchical clustering identifying pedagogical alignments (e.g., the *UC Core Cluster*, the *Pragmatic Tool Dyad*, and the *Critical Theory Outlier*).

## Generative AI Disclosure & Citation

In alignment with the institutional guidelines and citation practices examined in this synthesis (see [Chapter 4: Institutional Guidelines, Policies, and Citation Practices](chapters/04-policies-guidelines.qmd)), this section provides full transparency regarding the use of Generative Artificial Intelligence (GenAI) in the creation of this project.

### Tool & Model Specifications
- **Large Language Model (Extraction & Synthesis)**: Gemini 3.7 Flash (`gemini-3.7-flash`), hosted via Google/Dreamlab API.
- **Embedding Model (Vector Semantic Analysis)**: Gemini Embedding 2 (`gemini-embedding-2`) and Nomic Embed Text (`nomic-embed-text:latest` via Ollama).
- **Execution Pipeline**: Custom Python pipeline (`analysis.py`) executing structured JSON extraction, vector similarity scoring, and hierarchical clustering.

### Prompting & AI Assistance Role
GenAI was employed in three distinct capacities:
1. **Structured Data Extraction**: Extracted formal definitions, student outcomes, instructor goals, named frameworks, and supporting verbatim quotes from the scraped raw text of 11 university library guides.
2. **Semantic Representation**: Generated high-dimensional vector embeddings for each institution to construct the pairwise cosine similarity matrix.
3. **Thematic Qualitative Synthesis**: Drafted initial thematic categorizations (e.g., *Balanced Hybrid*, *Tool-Use*, and *Critical/Ethical* typologies) and cross-institutional affinity explanations based on the similarity clusters.

### Grounding & Quality Control (Human-in-the-Loop)
To safeguard research integrity and prevent hallucination, the following controls were implemented:
- **Verbatim Quote Verification**: All extracted quotes were programmatically matched word-for-word against the source guides. Only quotes achieving a 100% literal match are included in the final report, yielding a pipeline fidelity score of **>85%**.
- **Human Editing & Verification**: All AI-synthesized narrative reports, classifications, and cluster interpretations were thoroughly reviewed, edited, corrected, and validated by the researcher to ensure academic accuracy, conceptual coherence, and analytical depth.

### Citation Format (APA 7th Edition)
To cite the GenAI contribution to this project, use the following reference:
> Google. (2025). *Gemini 3.7 Flash* (Large language model). Google AI. https://deepmind.google/technologies/gemini/

### Citation Format (MLA 9th Edition)
> "Structured extraction and thematic synthesis of AI Literacy LibGuides" prompt. *ChatGPT/Gemini 3.7 Flash*, Google/Dreamlab API, 2026, https://github.com/UCSB-Library-Research-Data-Services/AI-Literacy.
